{{Current events|year=2019|month=04|day=14|content=

<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Disasters and accidents
*[[Tornadoes of 2019]]
**At least eight people are killed in the [[Southern United States]] amid severe storms bringing floods and tornadoes. [https://abcnews.go.com/Travel/wireStory/strong-storms-us-south-kill-injure-dozens-62396473 (ABC News)]
;International relations
*[[Libyan Civil War (2014–present)|Second Libyan Civil War]]
**[[Field marshal (Libya)|Field Marshal]] [[Khalifa Haftar]] of the [[Libyan National Army|LNA]] visits [[Cairo]] for a meeting with [[Egypt]]ian [[President of Egypt|President]] [[Abdel Fattah el-Sisi]], who has supported the LNA in its [[2019 Western Libya offensive|military operation]] against the rival [[Government of National Accord|GNA]] in [[Tripoli]]. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2019/apr/14/libya-crisis-egypt-sisi-backs-haftar-assault-on-tripoli (''The Guardian'')]
;Law and crime
*At least one person is killed and three others wounded in a [[drive-by shooting]] outside a [[nightclub]] in [[Melbourne]], [[Australia]]. [https://www.news.com.au/news/national/multiple-people-shot-outside-nightclub-in-melbourne/news-story/a4f520def2f0f9dfba6b26f1c46c58c5 (News.com.au)]
*One person is killed and another injured in a shooting in a church in the [[British Columbia]] city of [[Salmon Arm]]. The suspected shooter was wrestled to the ground by churchgoers, police say. [https://www.cbc.ca/news/canada/british-columbia/salmon-arm-church-of-christ-shooting-1.5097816 (CBC)]
;Politics and elections
*[[2019 Finnish parliamentary election]]
**[[Social Democratic Party of Finland|Social Democratic Party]] takes a narrow victory with 40 seats, while [[Finns Party]] comes close second with 39 seats. [https://yle.fi/uutiset/osasto/news/sdp_takes_top_spot_populists_rally_heavy_losses_for_pms_centre_in_finnish_election/10739392 (Yle)]
*[[2020 United States presidential election]], [[2020 Democratic Party presidential primaries]], [[Pete Buttigieg 2020 presidential campaign]]
**[[Pete Buttigieg]], Mayor of [[South Bend, Indiana]], announces he is running for the [[Democratic Party (United States)|Democratic Party's]] nomination to be [[President of the United States]] in the 2020 presidential election. [https://www.nbcnews.com/politics/2020-election/pete-buttigieg-officially-announces-2020-presidential-campaign-n994046 (NBC News)]
;Sports
*[[2019 Masters Tournament]]
**[[Tiger Woods]] wins the [[Masters Tournament]] in [[Augusta National Golf Club|Augusta, Georgia]], his first [[Men's major golf championships|major]] golf win in [[2008 U.S. Open (golf)|11 years]] and his first win at the Masters since [[2005 Masters Tournament|2005]]. [https://myfox8.com/2019/04/14/tiger-woods-wins-masters-first-major-win-since-2008/ (WGHP)] [https://www.nytimes.com/2019/04/14/sports/tiger-woods-wins-masters.html (''The New York Times'')]
